title: raid_marks
summary: MSUI carries the full MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE wire and 8-slot board, renders current Benilla's fixed one-world-unit overhead mark as a depth-tested, no-depth-write camera-facing world quad when no V-plate is live, and moves the same atlas cell to the exact 0.02gx left-hanging V-plate child when a plate is live. The projected ImGui compatibility adapter is gone; focused LUT, state, source-boundary and wiring checks pass, with only live occlusion/pixel verification outstanding.

openItems.text: No overhead raid-mark billboard on marked world units (Benilla raid_marks.rs: fixed 1x1 world-unit camera-facing quad from the UI-RaidTargetingIcons 4x2 atlas, seated one line-pitch above the unit's overhead name block, bare anchor when no name shows).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added RaidMarkerUiLaw's fixed 1-world-unit, bottom-seated square and 4x2 atlas law plus DrawRaidMarks for every streamed guid on the tracked 8-slot board. The projected adapter preserves Benilla geometry but is not yet world-depth-occluded.

openItems.text: No nameplate/V-plate raid-icon child, and no plate-vs-billboard mutual exclusion (a plated unit should show the mark on its plate instead of the world billboard).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: DrawNameplate now renders the marked unit's exact 0.02gx square with RIGHT seated at plate LEFT, vertically centered; DrawRaidMarks excludes precisely those live V-plate candidates.

openItems.text: TargetFrame raid-target icon is explicitly classified NOT-DRAWN in Program.UnitFrames.cs:133 - a marked target shows no icon on the target frame either.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Re-triaged against current Benilla: its first-party target frame defines no TargetRaidTargetIcon region. SetRaidTargetIconTexture is retained as an addon-facing helper, while first-party marks render on world/nameplate surfaces. Removed this stale parity classification.

openItems.text: GroupUiLaw.RaidTargetIndex (the Lua-facing 1..8 index) is defined but never consumed, so no UI surface reflects the tracked board at all.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: GroupUiLaw.RaidTargetIndex now drives the V-plate icon while the slot board directly drives each mutually-exclusive overhead billboard.

openItems.text: Move the overhead raid-mark adapter from the projected ImGui background surface into the world batch so terrain and walls depth-occlude the fixed camera-facing quad exactly like Benilla.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: RaidMarkerBillboards feeds the shared world renderer's authored-texture billboard pass. The pass uses the exact bottom-centered one-unit LUT and 4x2 atlas cell, camera-facing right/up basis, alpha blend, depth test ON, depth writes OFF, and no ImGui projection path.

openItems.text: Focused geometry/state/source checks pass. Needs an owner-run live marked-unit walk behind terrain and WMO walls, plus V-plate toggle and multi-scale pixel comparison; no deployment or runtime control was performed.
